And we are excited to apply our technical and creative skills to real world NASA Data. We are currently looking for some energetic teammates to round out our roster.
summary:
It is a lightweight, interactive space training arcade designed for children aged 7 to 12.
It contains six mini-games that help children improve their reflexes, timing, memory and hand-eye coordination.
Unlike many modern web games, Cosmic Cadets does not use intrusive advertisements or heavy frameworks. It is designed to be kid-safe, fast, accessible and playable even without an internet connection.
Our main aim is to combine fun, learning and technology.
details: * What does your project do, and how does it work? Cosmic Cadets is a browser-based space exploration game that runs smoothly on modern web technologies without requiring any installation. * What benefits does it have? It offers instant accessibility across devices, engaging entertainment, and high-performance responsiveness. * What is the intended impact? It aims to captivate users with an immersive space adventure while showcasing modern web development capabilities. * What tools did you use? It was built using frontend web technologies, managed via GitHub, and deployed live on Vercel. * How is your project creative? It combines a unique cosmic explorer theme with polished user interface design and interactive gameplay elements. * What factors did your team consider? The team prioritized cross-device responsiveness, smooth user experience, fast loading speeds, and reliable cloud hosting.
